body:
Review findings addressed (pushed to `issue/230-snug-cylinder`, head `8dfcfd7`).

1. **Code conflict in `crates/ui/src/state.rs`** (StockFit handler). Merged main at `06a194c`, which is main just before #277, so this push changes nothing under `.github/`. The resolution follows the review's suggestion: main's `apply_stock_fit` flow stays, and the cylinder branch now feeds it the snug fit (`model::solid_world_radius_about`, then `stock::fit_cylinder_about`). A `None` still refuses with `stock fit refused: models have no usable extent`, through `apply_stock_fit`.
2. **`RECOMMENDED.md` conflict.** The PR's entry moved verbatim to `docs/decisions/230-snug-cylinder.md` (the per-PR decisions rule), and `RECOMMENDED.md` is main's again.

No other findings were open. `git merge-tree` of the new head with current `origin/main` (`f7deca0`, after #222) is clean.

**Tests.** Run on a throwaway merge of the new head with `origin/main` `f7deca0`, from `crates/ui`:
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-geometry --no-fail-fast`: all green.
  - geometry: lib 39 (includes `a_snug_cylinder_is_the_revolved_radius_plus_the_allowance`), geo2d 15, headless_bin 3, repair 10, slice 10.
  - ui: lib 270 passed / 2 ignored, boundary 3, boundary_picks 6, edge_loop_pick 2, egui_app 3, feedback 6, fixtures 7, gpu_render 9, machine 6, models 4, operations 31, shell 20 (includes `a_cylinder_fit_round_a_turned_part_is_snug` and `cylinder_fit_keeps_the_cylinder_choice`), theme_files 14, trace_composite 4, trace_parity 5.
  - Snapshots match; none were regenerated.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- The app change is one new function. Clippy covers it, but the app test suites were not run.

**Overlap with other open PRs** (`git merge-tree`):
- No conflict with #251.
- #188 and #213 conflict only where they already conflict with main.
